programs.name: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM)
programs.feeNote: Official Indore fee page 'Fee Structure for PGDM Programmes 2027-29': Year 1 Rs 6,80,000 + Year 2 Rs 6,70,000 = Rs 13,50,000 (6 trimester instalments: 2,50,000 / 2,20,000 / 2,10,000 / 2,50,000 / 2,10,000 / 2,10,000). Excludes refundable security deposit Rs 15,000, hostel (AC double Rs 1,15,000 a year for 2026-27, plus Rs 10,000 refundable hostel deposit; mess extra) and GST/other taxes if notified. Merit scholarships on CAT/MAT/CMAT/XAT scores (up to Rs 5,00,000) are listed on the same page.
programs.intakeNote: NIRF 2026 data submitted by Jaipuria Indore (hosted on jaipuria.ac.in): sanctioned intake 180 for PG 2-year programmes in 2024-25 and 2023-24; 173 first-year students admitted in 2023-24.
programs.placementNote: Median salary of placed PG-2-year graduates as submitted by the institute for NIRF 2026: Rs 9,00,000 for graduating year 2024-25 (169 graduated, 167 placed); Rs 8,40,000 for 2023-24; Rs 8,01,000 for 2022-23. No Indore-specific average published; the group placement page (2024-26) gives only all-campus highest Rs 24.11 LPA and top-10%/top-20% averages, which are not used here.

selectionProcess.name: Application and shortlisting
selectionProcess.detail: Common 'uncampus' application (Rs 1,000 admission process fee) choosing campus and programme; valid CAT 2026 / XAT 2027 / CMAT / MAT / GMAT score required; graduation with min. 50% marks (final-year students eligible, graduation by 30 Jun 2027). Interviews by invitation only.

selectionProcess.name: Case analysis and personal interview; final selection
selectionProcess.weightage: Test score 45%, Case Analysis 10%, PI 25%, Academics (X, XII, degree) 15%, Work experience/sports/extra-curricular 3%, Diversity 2%
selectionProcess.detail: Offer letter (incl. scholarship decision) within two weeks; admission confirmed by paying the first-trimester fee.

selectionWeightage.note: Selection weightage published on the Jaipuria Indore admissions page for PGDM 2027-29 (test = CAT 2026/XAT 2027/CMAT/MAT/GMAT).

keyDates.notes: No 2027 application deadline or interview dates published on the official Indore admissions page as of 2026-11-12.

nirf.note: Jaipuria Indore (NIRF ID IR-M-S-179) is not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; the ranked Jaipuria entries are the Noida (41) and Jaipur (74) campuses. 101-125 band not checked.
